title: Canadian Rockies Tour Louise Moraine Lake and Emerald Lake
includes: Roundtrip transportation in an air-conditioned Van or Bus
Pick-up and drop-off service from Calgary, Canmore or Banff
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
If you have infant, message us before bookings.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Canadian Rockies on this full-day adventure starting from Calgary, Canmore, or Banff. Journey through breathtaking landscapes, including the iconic Castle Mountain, and experience the beauty of Lake Louise and Moraine Lake. Capture unforgettable views of the turquoise waters and majestic peaks, followed by a relaxing lunch in Lake Louise Village. Continue to Emerald Lake, a serene gem in Yoho National Park, before marveling at the Natural Bridge rock formation. This tour promises a perfect blend of natural beauty and memorable experiences in one of the world’s most picturesque regions.

The tour offers a more personalized and comfortable experience with small groups, allowing guests to enjoy the Canadian Rockies at a relaxed pace. Unlike large bus tours, we provide flexible stops, ample time for photos, and a friendly guide.
